AdaptationSummary: Reflection-based CLR integration is not compiled; deliberate scalar/function-handle host crossings replace it.
Date/time zones, eval, dynamically generated Function bodies, user regular expressions and debugger statements report explicit profile omissions.
Recursive parser/evaluator/native call paths and native loops use configurable cooperative execution, size and allocation accounting guards.
Numeric parsing uses Framework-compatible TryParse with explicit ECMAScript overflow handling; bound argument lists preserve duplicates.
Allocation accounting units are not measured CLR heap bytes. Limits bound known operations/sizes and accumulate charged units until realm recreation.
Original licenses and Dtoa file notices are retained; parser credits remain bundled Esprima port with upstream revision unspecified.
